vanderbilt: A light-skinned man around 60, with a long, broad oval face, high receding forehead, rounded chin, and prominent straight nose with a rounded tip. His thinning, wavy hair is swept back, darker on top and gray at the temples, with loose curls above the ears. Bushy gray sideburns extend down his cheeks to the jaw; his upper lip and chin are clean-shaven. Deep-set eyes, heavy brows, forehead creases, and crow’s-feet frame a closed-mouth, unsmiling expression. His head turns slightly toward the viewer’s left. He wears a mid-19th-century dark coat with broad lapels, a white shirt with a high standing collar, and a wide dark cravat tied in a large bow with hanging ends.
classroom: Rectangular classroom viewed diagonally from the rear left at standing eye height. Rows of narrow brown wooden desks and matching chairs on gray metal frames face the right wall. A large dark green chalkboard covers that wall, beside pinned papers and above exposed white conduits. A raised dark wooden platform holds a gray teacher’s desk, black monitor, and chair near the windows. Tall gridded windows span the far wall, with patterned upper panes, clear lower panes showing trees, and several box air conditioners inset high up. Green square lockers stand against the left wall. Cream walls have beige lower sections. Glossy dark brown flooring reflects daylight. White ceiling beams carry fluorescent fixtures, fans, and a suspended projector.
bugatti: A low, wide Bugatti two-door coupe, viewed from the front-left corner. The body is pale metallic ice blue with mirror-polished silver side panels and a dark roof. A large silver-edged C-shaped curve surrounds the side window and deep intake behind the door. The short nose has a tall black horseshoe grille with a small red Bugatti badge, broad black mesh lower intakes, and a glossy black splitter. Narrow headlights contain four rectangular LED elements each. Raised front fenders flank a sculpted hood with long recessed channels. The steep, dark windshield has one diagonal wiper. Large wheels have angular silver-and-black split spokes and low-profile tires. Small ice-blue mirrors project from the doors.
twain: An elderly, light-skinned man around seventy, with a long, broad face, prominent rounded nose, deep-set eyes, heavy under-eye creases, and a furrowed brow. Thick, bushy white eyebrows extend outward. His abundant white hair is loosely wavy, swept back high above the forehead and flaring widely over both ears. A large, dense white moustache covers his upper lip and droops in rounded points beside his mouth; his chin is clean-shaven. His lips are closed, with a stern, unsmiling expression and gaze slightly left of the viewer. He wears an early-1900s pale three-piece suit, broad notched lapels, a high white collar, and a small white bow tie with a dark central fastener.
flowerpot: A squat, thick-walled stone pot, roughly one-and-a-half times wider than tall, with a broad circular mouth, rounded rim, nearly straight sides and flat base. The surface is weathered grey-brown with pale beige edges and darker recesses; the interior is rough and undecorated. Beneath the rim runs a narrow band of deeply cut alternating triangles. The broad middle band is divided by vertical toothed borders into rectangular panels filled with angular triangles and intersecting diagonal grooves. The front-right panel contains a large four-lobed motif outlined by several concentric grooves. A second triangular border circles the bottom above a plain foot edge. One short, solid, flattened rectangular lug projects horizontally from the upper right side; no open spout.
banff: A vivid turquoise lake fills the lower half, darkening to blue beneath shadows at the far left shore. A towering wall of jagged gray mountains spans the background, with sheer, horizontally layered cliffs, pale scree slopes, and narrow patches of snow in gullies and beneath summits. Dense dark-green conifers cover the curving right shoreline and climb the hillside, extending toward the distant center. Small docks and colorful boats sit along the lower right bank. Rough, angular gray rock slabs form a foreground ledge across the bottom, beside a tall slender evergreen on the left. Bright daytime sunlight illuminates the lake and right-hand forest beneath a blue sky streaked with soft white clouds.
